description: Makes the execution handoff a required gate before a review-required task may move to READY_FOR_REVIEW. The gate combines the task execution preflight with the structured completion-handoff check, preventing a status-only transition from hiding missing validation, budget, or task/queue consistency evidence.
delta: tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md changes task-blueprint v7 to v8: the Review: REQUIRED completion path now requires `meridian execution ready-check` before setting task and queue state to READY_FOR_REVIEW. PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md changes execution-assets v1 to v2 and declares `tasks/handoffs/<TASK-ID>.md` as the canonical completion-handoff location.
verification: tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md carries capability=task-blueprint v8 and names meridian execution ready-check before READY_FOR_REVIEW
meridian execution ready-check rejects incomplete handoff or invalid preflight and passes only when both gates pass
